input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 auto-renews each Order Form for twelve months (acceptable term length) but requires 180 days' advance non-renewal notice. That exceeds both the preferred window (30 days) and the fallback (no more than 60 days) and falls squarely in walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days). Pricing risk is already mitigated by Section 8.3, which caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, so no pricing change is needed. We therefore made the minimal edit to reach the preferred position: a 30-day opt-out window plus a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal; a 60-day window would be an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 180 to 30 days and add a 60-day Vendor renewal reminder
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days and added a 60-day renewal reminder, since our playbook allows automatic twelve-month renewals only where we can exit on short notice (60 days at the outside). The renewal term and the Section 8.3 uplift cap are unchanged.

ops.oldText: unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
ops.newText: unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term. Vendor shall notify Customer of the upcoming renewal at least sixty days before the renewal date.
